claims.text: Little is a co-author of 'The deployment of a geomagnetic variometer station as auxiliary instrumentation for the study of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena', Geoscientific Instrumentation, Methods and Data Systems 14:335 (2025).

Vervelidou, Delacroix, Domine, Kelderman, Little and colleagues published the deployment of a geomagnetic variometer station as auxiliary UAP instrumentation in Geoscientific Instrumentation, Methods and Data Systems 14:335 (26 November 2025).

edges.label: SCU board member and co-author of the 2023 characteristics study
edges.note: Little is one of the few researchers who publishes with both SCU and the Galileo Project, which is a measure of how small the actual civil analytical bench is.

edges.label: Co-author on the 2025 geomagnetic variometer instrumentation paper
edges.note: Published in Geoscientific Instrumentation, Methods and Data Systems in November 2025 - a Copernicus geophysics journal publishing hardware installed specifically to look for UAP signatures.
